a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (operate until 8) almost surely kills us both. Waiting doesn't protect you either. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement silently. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round afterward so you can get your 4, and I'll give cells back if that helps you. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took as announced. If we're both still here, I'll operate every round from now on so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: You ended up with the cells; I have 0. That's fair given I announced first. The reserve is empty now, so please operate with me for two rounds to rebuild 4 cells. I'll take only those 4 and nothing more.
